# unwired baseline: declarations that production code reads nowhere.
# Generated by `unwired -write`. Entries are keyed by kind and qualified
# name, never by line, so an unrelated edit never needs a re-pin.
# The coordinate after each entry is a comment and is not matched.
#
# This file only shrinks. Adding an entry means accepting a declaration
# nothing reads, so put the reason on a # line above it.
#
# measured 2026-10-11: 1 of 1545 declarations across 133 packages and 306 files

# Decision: ADR-0058. The sdk is the surface a component author builds on,
# and serve.Tool is the entry point of a tool component. Its callers are the
# tool components that `gibson component new` generates from the adk template
# gibson/cmd/gibson/internal/scaffold/templates/tool/main.go.tmpl:72. A
# generated component lives outside every first-party repo, so no scan can
# load it as a consumer. Delete this entry only with the template call.
func serve.Tool	# serve/tool.go:31
